data.description:
VALIDATE QUERY API TEST COVERAGE

PURPOSE: Verify tests exist for all Query API methods before extracting to separate module

FILES TO CHECK:
- cortical/got/query_builder.py - Query class
- cortical/got/graph_walker.py - GraphWalker class
- cortical/got/path_finder.py - PathFinder class
- cortical/got/pattern_matcher.py - PatternMatcher class

TESTS TO VERIFY:
- tests/unit/test_got_query*.py - Query API tests

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
1. List all public methods in each Query API class
2. Verify each has corresponding test coverage
3. Run: pytest tests/unit/test_got*.py -v --tb=short
4. Coverage report for got/ modules

DELIVERABLE:
Report with:
- List of methods and their test status
- Any gaps identified
- Overall coverage percentage

GUARDRAILS - DO NOT:
- Modify any code
- Create new tests (just validate existing)

VERIFY: pytest tests/unit/test_got*.py -v --cov=cortical/got --cov-report=term-missing | tail -30

properties.retrospective: Audit complete: 99.4% coverage, 218 tests. Ready for extraction.
